Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment — A classic high-desert soaring day with strong thermal activity (domain peak w* 676 ft/min), deep boundary layers (site max 6951 ft AGL), and clear skies. Southwest flow intensifies through the afternoon, making wind the primary limiting factor. Site-specific wind speeds climb to 30–40 mph at exposed launches after midday — fly early, land early.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury: Marginal — wind starts light SE but rapidly clocks SW and strengthens to 30 mph by 4pm (cross from preferred 104°). Window: 9am–12pm. Peak w* 429 ft/min, ceiling 4006 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 8.7 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Hallelujah: Favorable — SW flow is within preferred sector (270° ± 45°); peak wind 23 mph manageable. Watch 18% overdevelopment for mid-day cumulus. Window: 10am–3pm. Peak w* 540 ft/min, ceiling 6951 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 10.2 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Slide Mountain: Unfavorable — wind SW 24 mph at 8am, increasing to 32 mph by noon, significantly cross/strong for S/SE launch. Window: none recommended. Peak w* modest 384 ft/min, ceiling only 3509 ft AGL.
  • McClellan: Favorable — wind stays SW 13–22 mph, aligned with SW/S preferred sector. Excellent thermals. Window: 10am–2pm. Peak w* 598 ft/min, ceiling 6879 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 10.2 °C/km) — advanced pilots only. Watch 23% overdevelopment.
  • West McClellan: Marginal — wind SW 21–28 mph (within W/NW tolerance but strong). 45% overdevelopment risk is high; watch for cumulus congestus. Window: 10am–1pm. Peak w* 531 ft/min, ceiling 6138 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 9.9 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — wind SW 33 mph at 8am, peaking 40 mph by 4pm; extreme for a thermal/sled site. Window: none recommended. Peak w* 477 ft/min, ceiling 3886 ft AGL.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Marginal — wind SW 15–22 mph cross from preferred E/NE launch; evening drainage flow may be brief and light. Window: 10am–1pm. Peak w* 560 ft/min, ceiling 6376 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 10.1 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Duck Hill: Favorable — wind light SW 14–18 mph within broad NW/N tolerance; evening soaring possible if drainage sets up. Window: 11am–6pm. Peak w* 534 ft/min, ceiling 6292 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 10.1 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Daydreams: Favorable — wind WSW 15–28 mph well-aligned with SW launch (225°). 100% overdevelopment risk is a red flag — expect persistent cloud shading/quenching after onset. Window: 8am–12pm early ridge soaring. Peak w* 270 ft/min, ceiling 3441 ft AGL.

Hazards

  • Thermal overdevelopment: Daydreams 100%, West McClellan 45%, McClellan 23%, Hallelujah 18%. LCL near PBLH means clouds will form inside thermals and shade/quench lift. Monitor for cumulus congestus.
  • Low-level shear: Peak layer speed shear ≥5 mph at Kingsbury, Hallelujah, Slide, McClellan, Peavine, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill, Daydreams. Turbulent low levels during thermal hours.
  • Rotor/lee turbulence: Strong SW flow (~30–40 mph) over Peavine Mountain and Carson Range ridgelines will generate mechanical turbulence and lee-side rotors. Avoid downwind terrain shadow.
  • Strong winds: Slide Mountain and Peavine Mountain see sustained 32–40 mph by early afternoon — beyond safe launch/launch margins for most pilots.
  • Sharp thermals: Lapse rates 8.3–10.2 °C/km at most sites indicate punchy, narrow-core thermals — advanced pilots only.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.
LCL (Lifted Condensation Level) — altitude where rising air reaches its dew point; theoretical cloud base.
Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
Wind thresholds: orange = 12 mph, red = 18 mph.
